items.title: Overall redevelopment vision
items.proposal: Premium, safe, durable residential environment with transparent commercial/residential planning.

items.title: Architect and project consultants
items.proposal: Society to appoint/approve qualified independent architect, PMC, legal adviser and other experts; disclose scope and fees.

items.title: Building configuration
items.proposal: Proposed number of floors, wings and building height to be disclosed with approved-plan basis: __________.

items.title: Flat count and density
items.proposal: Maximum proposed number of flats: __________; explain impact on lifts, parking, amenities and infrastructure.

items.title: Residential use protection
items.proposal: Existing members’ homes to remain residential; sale component use and any mixed-use permissions to comply with approvals and agreed safeguards.

items.title: Approvals and development potential
items.proposal: Developer to disclose FSI/TDR/premium/incentive/ancillary FSI assumptions, costs, approvals and feasibility calculations.

items.title: MahaRERA
items.proposal: Where applicable, project to be registered with MahaRERA before marketing/sale as legally required; registration details shared with Society.

items.title: Offer validity and disclosures
items.proposal: Written offer to state validity, assumptions, exclusions, approvals required, taxes, timelines and conditions.

title: Existing members’ homes and area entitlements

items.title: Existing area verification
items.proposal: Each member’s existing carpet area to be verified from records and jointly reconciled before final offer comparison.

items.title: Additional free carpet area
items.proposal: Minimum additional area proposed: _______% of verified existing carpet area; specify carpet-area definition and exclusions clearly.

items.title: Area statement
items.proposal: Member-wise statement to show existing carpet area, free additional carpet area, total new carpet area and any optional purchasable area.

items.title: Optional extra area purchase
items.proposal: Rate: ₹________ per sq. ft. plus clearly itemised applicable taxes, stamp duty and registration charges.

items.title: No hidden deductions
items.proposal: No reduction in promised carpet area through ambiguous definitions, deductions or later reinterpretation.

items.title: Flat layout and usability
items.proposal: Members to review sample layouts; adequate ventilation, daylight, storage, furniture placement and practical room dimensions.

items.title: Permanent Alternate Accommodation Agreement (PAAA)
items.proposal: Individual PAAA with every eligible member, aligned with Development Agreement and applicable law; developer to bear agreed documentation costs.

items.title: Commercial premises
items.proposal: Commercial owners to receive a separate member-wise schedule covering area, frontage, access, signage, services and other agreed entitlements.

items.title: Corpus / hardship compensation
items.proposal: Proposed amount: ₹________ per sq. ft. of verified existing area and/or minimum ₹________ per member; define payment dates.

items.title: Corpus calculation example
items.proposal: Illustrative amount for agreed reference area of ______ sq. ft.: ₹________ per member.

items.title: Corpus payment security
items.proposal: Payment milestones, default interest and security for unpaid amounts to be written into the agreements.

items.title: Transit rent – Year 1
items.proposal: ₹________ per month or ₹________ per sq. ft.; specify escalation date and payment in advance.

items.title: Transit rent – subsequent years
items.proposal: Year 2: ₹________; Year 3: ₹________; further delay: escalation of _______% or ₹________ per year.

items.title: Rent payment protection
items.proposal: Rent to be paid before each rental period; agreed delay compensation and payment security to apply.

items.title: Shifting charges
items.proposal: Inward and outward shifting: ₹________ per move / ₹________ total per member.

items.title: Brokerage
items.proposal: Brokerage for temporary accommodation: __________ (suggestion: one month’s rent, subject to agreement).

items.title: Refundable rental deposit
items.proposal: Deposit amount and refund responsibility to be recorded; no member should bear an unagreed loss caused by project delay.

items.title: Temporary accommodation documentation
items.proposal: Applicable leave-and-license stamp duty, registration and related charges: responsibility to be expressly allocated.

items.title: Taxes and transaction costs
items.proposal: A written responsibility matrix for GST, stamp duty, registration, approvals, legal/architect fees and other costs; no unspecified member liability.

items.title: Optional purchases
items.proposal: Any member-funded upgrades or extra area must be optional, separately priced and documented.

items.title: Vacant possession trigger
items.proposal: Members to vacate only after agreed preconditions are fulfilled, including executed agreements, possession/payment protections and required approvals as advised by counsel.

items.title: Construction start
items.proposal: Target date for commencement and milestone schedule to be specified, with commencement certificate and other required permissions.

items.title: Completion timeline
items.proposal: Target completion: ______ months from the contractually defined commencement date; extensions only as expressly agreed and legally permissible.

items.title: Delay compensation
items.proposal: Monthly delay compensation of ₹________ per member / agreed formula until lawful possession is offered and required conditions are met.

items.title: Performance bank guarantee
items.proposal: Unconditional, irrevocable bank guarantee from an acceptable scheduled bank: ₹________ or _______% of an independently assessed amount; validity and invocation conditions to be defined by legal adviser.

items.title: Funding and encumbrances
items.proposal: Developer to disclose funding arrangements and any proposed security/charge; Society property must not be encumbered contrary to the agreed legal protections.

items.title: Termination and step-in rights
items.proposal: Clearly defined events of default, notice/cure periods, termination rights and remedies for prolonged delay, abandonment, insolvency or failure to maintain security.

items.title: Indemnity and insurance
items.proposal: Appropriate indemnities and insurance for third-party claims, adjacent-property damage, worker injury, fire, construction risks, statutory violations and damage caused by the project.

items.title: Dispute resolution
items.proposal: Escalation, dispute resolution, jurisdiction and interim protection provisions to be reviewed by the Society’s legal adviser.

items.title: Handover conditions
items.proposal: Possession only with required Occupation Certificate/permissions, functioning essential services, agreed amenities, defect list and handover documents.

items.title: Structure and soil
items.proposal: Soil investigation and structural design/certification by qualified professionals; compliance with applicable codes and seismic/wind-load requirements.

items.title: Construction quality
items.proposal: Material brands or equivalent approved standards, workmanship tolerances, inspection rights and test certificates to be documented.

items.title: Defect liability
items.proposal: At least the legally applicable defect-liability protection; proposed contractual period: ______ years from the relevant handover/OC date, subject to legal review.

items.title: Fire and life safety
items.proposal: Approved fire systems, alarms, extinguishers, emergency lighting, signage, evacuation routes and required fire approvals.

items.title: Lifts
items.proposal: Number, capacity and make/specification: ______; adequate passenger lifts and stretcher/cargo provision where feasible; power backup and maintenance plan.

items.title: Electrical systems
items.proposal: Adequate sanctioned load, quality wiring, MCB/RCCB/ELCB protection, earthing, surge protection and clearly labelled distribution boards.

items.title: Water supply and storage
items.proposal: Adequate municipal supply, storage capacity, treatment where required, metering where feasible and standby pumps.

items.title: Water resilience
items.proposal: Rainwater harvesting and lawful alternative arrangements where feasible and approved; no reliance on an unapproved borewell.

items.title: Plumbing and drainage
items.proposal: Quality concealed plumbing, accessible maintenance points, leak testing, drainage capacity and prevention of cross-contamination.

items.title: Power backup and solar
items.proposal: Backup for lifts, essential common areas, pumps, fire/life-safety systems and other agreed loads; solar generation and its intended loads to be specified.

items.title: Internet, DTH and intercom
items.proposal: Provision for fibre/internet, DTH, intercom and video door phone without avoidable exposed wiring.

items.title: Gas piping
items.proposal: Gas pipeline provision subject to utility approval and safety requirements; clearly allocate meter and internal connection costs.

items.title: Waterproofing and termite treatment
items.proposal: Documented treatment, warranties and test reports for terraces, wet areas, basements and other vulnerable locations.

items.title: Flooring
items.proposal: Vitrified tiles or equivalent quality; specify make/grade, size, skirting and finish.

items.title: Doors and windows
items.proposal: Durable main door with safety fittings; quality internal doors; aluminium/uPVC windows, mosquito mesh and safe hardware.

items.title: Kitchen
items.proposal: Granite or equivalent platform, stainless-steel sink, suitable backsplash tiles, adequate electrical points and water connections.

items.title: Kitchen storage and appliances
items.proposal: State whether modular cabinets, chimney and hob are included or optional; identify make, scope and warranty.

items.title: Bathrooms and toilets
items.proposal: Full-height or agreed-height tiles, anti-skid flooring, quality sanitaryware and CP fittings; specify brands or equivalent.

items.title: Bathroom usability
items.proposal: Adequate ventilation/exhaust, mirror/basin counter, towel/health-faucet points and provision for shower partition.

items.title: Electrical points
items.proposal: Member to approve a standard electrical layout; adequate sockets for kitchen appliances, AC, washing machine and work-from-home needs.

items.title: Air-conditioner provision
items.proposal: Sleeved copper-drain route and outdoor-unit location for bedrooms/hall, subject to approved façade and drainage design.

items.title: Inverter provision
items.proposal: Dedicated inverter circuit for agreed lights/fans and safe changeover arrangement, if included in the offer.

items.title: Internal finish and paint
items.proposal: Specified plaster system, paint brand/grade, coats and finish; samples to be approved before bulk execution.

items.title: Ceiling height and ventilation
items.proposal: Clear finished ceiling height to be stated in the offer; adequate natural light and cross-ventilation where layout permits.

items.title: Dry balcony / utility
items.proposal: Practical utility space and washing-machine point/drainage, subject to approved design and area entitlement.

items.title: Member parking entitlement
items.proposal: Proposed parking allocation: ______ per eligible existing member, subject to applicable law and approved design; specify location and dimensions.

items.title: Parking design
items.proposal: Preference for independently usable, non-dependent parking; any stack/puzzle system to be transparently disclosed with specifications and operating costs.

items.title: Visitor and accessible parking
items.proposal: Visitor parking and accessible parking provisions to be assessed against applicable requirements and site feasibility.

items.title: Entrance and lobby
items.proposal: Secure, well-lit entrance lobby with durable flooring, signage and step-free access where feasible.

items.title: Society office and records
items.proposal: Furnished society office with storage, electrical/data points and space for meetings and records.

items.title: Security infrastructure
items.proposal: CCTV in agreed common areas, access control, video door phone, secure gate and suitable watchman/security cabin.

items.title: Compound and landscape
items.proposal: Secure compound wall, main and pedestrian gates, lighting, drainage, planting and safe pedestrian pathways.

items.title: Staircases and corridors
items.proposal: Non-slip finishes, handrails, ventilation, emergency lighting and unobstructed escape routes.

items.title: Terrace and recreation
items.proposal: Waterproofed terrace and agreed landscaped/recreation area; define permitted use, access, safety and maintenance.

items.title: Staff facilities
items.proposal: Common toilet and appropriate housekeeping/security facilities, subject to plan and feasibility.

items.title: Waste management
items.proposal: Segregated waste storage and collection area designed to minimise odour, pests and inconvenience.

items.title: Accessibility
items.proposal: Step-free access where feasible, accessible routes and other measures required by applicable regulations.

items.title: Maintenance handover
items.proposal: As-built drawings, warranties, equipment manuals, service contracts and training for Society-appointed representatives.

title: Commercial premises and protection of residents

items.title: Commercial owner requirements
items.proposal: Record each commercial owner’s area, frontage, access, signage, parking, loading, utilities and compensation/temporary arrangements separately.

items.title: Separate access and circulation
items.proposal: Assess separate residential and commercial access, lifts and circulation where feasible and permitted.

items.title: Noise, odour and vibration
items.proposal: Design and enforce controls to prevent commercial activity from unreasonably affecting homes, balconies, windows and common areas.

items.title: Kitchen exhaust / restaurant use
items.proposal: Any restaurant/hotel exhaust, grease control, filtration, fire protection and discharge route must be designed and approved to protect residents and comply with law.

items.title: Fire safety and waste
items.proposal: Commercial units to meet applicable fire, waste, grease-trap and pest-control requirements; responsibility for operation and upkeep to be clear.

items.title: Utility metering and costs
items.proposal: Separate metering where feasible and a transparent method to allocate electricity, water, repairs and common expenses by use.

items.title: Deliveries and operations
items.proposal: Loading/unloading, delivery timing, staff/visitor movement, signage and traffic arrangements to minimise disturbance and obstruction.

items.title: Use restrictions and enforcement
items.proposal: Permitted commercial uses and mechanisms to address nuisance or safety violations to be reviewed by legal counsel and included where lawful.

items.title: Independent feasibility report
items.proposal: Compare proposed member benefits, sale component, project costs, approvals, timelines, risks and developer returns through the Society’s appointed professionals.

items.title: Offer comparison
items.proposal: Use a common comparison sheet for all developers: area, corpus, rent, parking, specifications, guarantees, timeline, exclusions and conditions.

items.title: Member consultation
items.proposal: Provide members sufficient time to review the proposal and submit written comments before decisions are taken.

items.title: Document access
items.proposal: Share relevant offers, feasibility assumptions, draft agreements, approval status and consultant recommendations with members, subject to lawful confidentiality.

items.title: Sample flat / material approvals
items.proposal: Provide material samples, specifications and sample layouts for review through a documented approval process before finalisation.

items.title: Change control
items.proposal: No material change to agreed area, specifications, amenities or member benefits without the contractually required Society/member approval.

items.title: Commercial and residential financial transparency
items.proposal: Show the financial impact of residential and commercial components separately where practicable, and explain assumptions affecting member benefits.

items.title: Final approval process
items.proposal: All appointments, selections, agreements and material decisions to follow applicable law, registered bye-laws and required General Body/SGM approvals.
